nodes.name: default.yaml
nodes.summary: Minimal default Monte Carlo configuration defining a fixed seed, 1000 scenarios, and normal distributions for capacity factor and LKR tariff. Serves as a lightweight smoke-test/default sampling spec for the risk engine.

nodes.name: dutchbay_all_scenarios_mc_2025Q4.yaml
nodes.summary: Consolidated 2025Q4 Monte Carlo registry bundling the Lender, Optimistic, and Pessimistic scenarios for comparative analysis, each with parameter overrides for capacity factor, CAPEX/kW, fixed O&M, and PPA tariff. Drives analytics.monte_carlo_v14 via LHS sampling with a fixed seed.

nodes.name: dutchbay_lendercase_2025Q4.yaml
nodes.summary: Lender-case Monte Carlo spec sampling capacity factor, tariff, total CAPEX, and annual OPEX, and reporting project IRR, NPV, and minimum DSCR across the 10/25/50/75/90 percentiles. Compact lender-grade risk configuration for the Dutch Bay 150MW wind project.

nodes.name: dutchbay_lendercase_mc_2025Q4.yaml
nodes.summary: CESSPIT v14-compliant lender base-case Monte Carlo configuration with conservative distributions for project capacity factor, total CAPEX (triangular), and annual OPEX (uniform), run via LHS over 1000 iterations. Defines the canonical lender scenario for the risk engine.

nodes.name: dutchbay_optimistic_mc_2025Q4.yaml
nodes.summary: Optimistic upside Monte Carlo configuration assuming higher capacity factors, lower CAPEX/OPEX, and stronger PPA pricing for the Dutch Bay 150MW wind project. Provides the best-case bound for comparative scenario risk analysis.

nodes.name: dutchbay_pessimistic_mc_2025Q4.yaml
nodes.summary: Pessimistic stress Monte Carlo configuration modeling lower capacity factors, construction overruns, spot-priced O&M, and weak/renegotiated PPA tariffs for the Dutch Bay 150MW wind project. Provides the worst-case downside bound for risk analysis.
